c74object.name: evi.xfade~
c74object.description: Crossfades between inputs using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'. A choice of mono or stereo setups are available.

inlet.description: Crossfades between inputs using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'

outlet.description: Mono or Left Xfaded Output (depending on 'mode')

objarg.name: xfade
objarg.description: A value in the range 0..1 sets the initial crossfade amount between the inputs. 0.5 = center.

objarg.name: mode
objarg.description: Mode can only be a typed in argument and is not dynamic. Mode switches between mono, swap and stereo inputs/outputs for the object. If mode == 2 new inlets appear for the additional inputs. If mode == 1 or 2 new outlets appear for the additional outputs.

method.name: float
method.description: In any mode, the far right inlet always accepts a float in the range 0..1 representing the Crossfade amount

method.name: signal
method.description: If 'mode' == 0 (mono, the default): In left inlet, audio input 1 to be crossfaded. In middle inlet, audio input 2 to be crossfaded. In far right inlet, the Crossfade value 0..1. If 'mode' == 1 (swap): In left inlet, audio input 1 to be swap faded. In middle inlet, audio input 2 to be swap faded. In far right inlet, the Crossfade value 0..1. If 'mode' == 2 (stereo): In left inlet, audio 1 left input to be crossfaded. In middle left inlet, audio 1 right input to be crossfaded. In middle right inlet, audio 2 left input to be crossfaded. In right inlet, audio 2 right input to be crossfaded. In far right inlet, the Crossfade value 0..1.

attribute.name: xfade
attribute.description: Crossfades between inputs using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'

attribute.name: mode
attribute.digest: Mode 0, 1, 2 (0 = mono, the default, 1 = swap, 2 = stereo)
attribute.description: mode can only be a typed in attribute and is not dynamic. Mode switches between mono, swap and stereo inputs/outputs for the object. If mode == 2 new inlets appear for the additional inputs. If mode == 1 or 2 new outlets appear for the additional outputs.
